note: RIDDLER SEAT 2 — the monomyth. Riddle: every story is one story in different clothes. The scholarly-mystic register. Equivalents ride this shelf (Ovid, Graves, Calasso). Everything walled; PD ancestors pullable.
interactions: 'monomyth' is coined FROM Joyce's Finnegans Wake — A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake (1944, w/ Henry Morton Robinson) came first; edge to the shakespeare shelf's Joyce
ancestors: Frazer's The Golden Bough (PD, pullable), Arnold van Gennep's Rites of Passage (1909), Jung's archetypes (edge: the existing jung shelf)
rival: Robert Graves' The White Goddess (1948) — the two grand-narratives of myth published within a year of each other
descendant: Star Wars (1977) is a citation of The Hero with a Thousand Faces; the world's biggest film is this shelf's most famous reader
descendant: the parables themselves — the clerk's ordinary world, threshold, return structure
pd_unpulled: Ovid: Metamorphoses (Brookes More trans., PG), Heroides, Amores, Ars Amatoria, Tristia, Fasti
walled: The Hero with a Thousand Faces (1949); A Skeleton Key to Finnegans Wake (1944, w/ H.M. Robinson)

The Masks of God, 4 vols (1959-68); The Flight of the Wild Gander (1969); Myths to Live By (1972); The Mythic Image (1974); Historical Atlas of World Mythology (1983-87); The Inner Reaches of Outer Space (1986); Transformations of Myth Through Time (1990)
The Power of Myth (1988, w/ Bill Moyers, posthumous); Goddesses (2013); Baksheesh and Brahman (journals)
Graves: I, Claudius (1934); Claudius the God (1934); The White Goddess (1948); Goodbye to All That (1929); The Greek Myths (1955); Count Belisarius (1938); Wife to Mr Milton (1943)
Calasso: The Marriage of Cadmus and Harmony (1988/93); The Ruin of Kasch (1983/94); Literature and the Gods (1993/2001); Ka (1996/98); The Celestial Hunter (2020)

equivalents.ovid: the monomyth before the word; metamorphosis as the one plot
equivalents.graves: the monomyth's rival grand-narrative; the Goddess as the one story
equivalents.calasso: the monomyth retold as if it were tonight's news
